page.title: Your Privacy & Confidentiality
page.subtitle: Executive-Level Discretion Guaranteed
page.description: I understand that career moves at the Director/VP level require absolute discretion. Your conversations, interview preparation, and career goals remain completely confidential.

hero.title: Your Career Move Stays Between Us
hero.description: As a senior leader, you can't afford to have your job search become office gossip. I provide the same level of confidentiality you'd expect from executive recruiters and career advisors.

commitments.title: Complete Discretion
commitments.description: I never share client names, companies, or any identifying information. Your coaching engagement is known only to you and me.

commitments.title: Secure Communications
commitments.description: All our conversations happen through encrypted channels. No recordings without explicit consent. No written notes shared externally.

commitments.title: NDA Available
commitments.description: For executives who require formal protection, I offer a mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement before our first session.

commitments.title: No Public Testimonials Required
commitments.description: Unlike other coaches, I never pressure clients for public reviews. Your success story remains private unless you choose otherwise.

commitments.title: No Employer Contact
commitments.description: I will never contact your current or prospective employers. Your job search timeline and targets are strictly confidential.

commitments.title: Data Deletion on Request
commitments.description: Upon request, I permanently delete all notes, communications, and any records related to our coaching engagement.

ndaSection.title: Formal NDA Protection
ndaSection.description: Many of my executive clients prefer the added security of a formal Non-Disclosure Agreement. I'm happy to sign a mutual NDA before we begin working together.

faq.question: Will anyone know I'm working with a coach?
faq.answer: Absolutely not. I never disclose client relationships. Your colleagues, HR, or recruiters will never hear from me or know about our work together.

faq.question: What if my company has a strict social media policy?
faq.answer: I never tag, mention, or reference clients on any platform. You won't appear in any of my marketing materials unless you explicitly request to share your success story.

faq.question: Can I use a personal email instead of work email?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Many executives prefer to use personal email and phone for coaching communications. I recommend this for maximum privacy.

faq.question: What happens to my session notes?
faq.answer: Session notes are stored securely and shared only with you. Upon request, I permanently delete all records of our engagement.

faq.question: Do you work with my competitors?
faq.answer: I maintain strict separation between clients at competing companies and never share strategies, approaches, or insights between them.
